g.text: Clinical reasoning and adaptive collaboration. MDAgents [1]
Memory. Environment and preference stores, procedural skills, session retrieval [23]
Tools. MCP, FHIR queries, DICOM interfaces and code execution [24]
Training. Experience extraction, verifiers and backbone updates. ExpeL [8]
Illustrative frameworks. Hermes [25] and AutoGen [26]. Clinician-directed workflows in
Context management (§3.1). Compression, cached prefixes and iteration budgets.
Persistent memory (§3.1). Bounded stores, databases, memory graphs, replacement and
Skill synthesis (§3.1). Trace2Skill [29], CoEvoSkills [30], SkillClaw [31], SkillRL [11],
Skill verification. Versioned artifacts, retained trajectories and held-out acceptance.
Candidate trigger composition. Novelty, performance, contradiction, consolidation, RL and
Tool integration (§3.2). MCP [24], FHIR, DICOM and composite imaging tools. MACRO [32]
Parallel collaboration (§3.2). Separate contexts, summary consolidation and shared
Verifiers and trajectory filtering. MedZERO [36], confidence-gated relabeling and SFT/DPO in
Training-data evolution. Changing task distributions and validated task–solution pairs in
Prompt engineering [5] and RadioRAG [6]. Retrieval, experience retention and
Detection (Table 2, §3.2). Medical-imaging analysis, feature memory and reusable
Augmentation (§4.3). Simulated clinical encounters and synthetic patients.
Question answering (§4.4). RadioRAG [6], Almanac [42] and general-domain
Experience reuse, information access, coordination and generated training material
Update targets and controls. Component updates, training-generator changes and
Clinical evaluation. Simulation, offline benchmarks, retrospective and external
Publication and traceability. Published, accepted and preprint reports. Source versions,
Hallucination and safety. Clinical verifiers, uncertainty and agent checkpoints [126]
Data privacy. PHI retention, de-identification, access and deletion controls [127]
Domain adaptation. Institutional shifts, local guidelines and controlled
Interpretability and trust. Evidence links, tool-action logs, component versions and clinician
Memory security. Injection detection and lifecycle controls from writing to rollback [131]
Scalability. Orchestration costs, pooled contexts, cached retrieval and model distillation.
Regulatory compliance. Specified update scope, clinical validation and change
Autonomy and safety. Graduated autonomy, escalation and physician adjudication.
Memory fragmentation. Hierarchical libraries, consolidation, adaptive retrieval and
Catastrophic forgetting. Prior-task testing, elastic weight consolidation and replay [133]
Over-reliance and de-skilling. Visible evidence, independent judgment and review of
Multimodal integration, federated training, multi-agent co-evolution, independent
Longitudinal care, clinician preferences, changing guidelines and institutional skill sharing with
